description: In relay_queue.rs, EnvelopeFile is deserialized from JSON with #[serde(default)] on require_tls. If an envelope file written by a future version of stoa omits the field (or if the field is named differently), deserialization silently succeeds with require_tls=false, potentially relaying a message that was enqueued with REQUIRETLS over a plaintext connection. This is a correctness-security issue. Fix: make require_tls non-optional with an explicit default of false only at the serde level, and add a post-deserialization validation step that logs a warning when a REQUIRETLS envelope is found without TLS available.
title: smtp: EnvelopeFile::require_tls silently defaults to false on missing field
